notes.title: V1.1.2 ready!
notes.content:
V1.1.2
- Added new previsualization system for single player.
- Keyboard controls update: switched direction input from numeric pad to arrow keys.
- Visual update on all maps.
- Custom sounds for every character.
- UI improvements: added new pause menu.
- General optimization.
- Fixed minor bugs.

We are constantly working on Blind Battle Championship so you can enjoy to the fullest!
